meta.description: 桌游本体 — 统一定义游戏中的静态结构概念与流程时序概念。不定义具体游戏规则。
meta.convention: 每个概念的 fields.required 表示：若另一个概念继承或引用此概念，则必须提供这些字段的值。程序递归收集父链上的所有 required 字段。

definition.zh: 可被识别、引用或操作的实体或抽象概念。
definition.en: An entity or abstract concept that can be identified, referenced, or operated upon.

description.zh: 该对象实例的唯一标识符。在整个游戏中不可重复。没有 id，程序无法区分、查找和关联此对象。
description.en: Unique identifier for this object instance. Must be unique within the game. Without an id, programs cannot distinguish, find, or relate this object.

description.zh: 描述该对象固有特征的键值对集合。由游戏规则预定义，描述对象「是什么」而非「此刻怎样」。注意：attributes 对应的是 Property（属性），不是 State（状态）。
description.en: A map of key-value pairs describing the object's intrinsic characteristics. Predefined by game rules. Describes what the object 'is', not what it 'currently is' (which would be State).

definition.zh: 游戏中的抽象逻辑容器，表示一组物件的空间归属关系。不依赖版图和实体，只由规则决定。
definition.en: An abstract logical container in the game, representing the spatial belonging of a set of objects. Independent of board and physical components; defined solely by rules.

description.zh: 该区域实例的唯一标识符。
description.en: Unique identifier for this zone instance.

description.zh: 声明此区域允许存放哪些类型的 Object。值为本体 concept id 数组（如 ["card", "token"]）。空数组 [] 表示不限制类型。程序校验 Transfer 时：若 what 的类型不在 contains 中，Transfer 非法。
description.en: Declares what types of Object this zone allows. Array of concept ids (e.g. ["card", "token"]). Empty array [] means any type is allowed. Programs check this when validating a Transfer.

description.zh: 此区域是否归属于某个玩家。null = 公共区域（供应堆、市场），所有玩家均可访问。指向 Player = 专属区域（手牌、个人面板），对手不可直接操作。
description.en: Whether this zone belongs to a player. null = public zone (supply, market). A Player reference = private zone (hand, personal board).

description.zh: 此区域的信息可见性。public = 全员可见；private = 仅 owner 可见；protected = owner 可选择展示；partially_public = 部分内容公开；hidden = 全员不可见。
description.en: Information visibility for this zone. public = all can see; private = only owner; protected = owner may reveal; partially_public = partial contents visible; hidden = no one can see.

description.zh: 可容纳的对象数量上限。null = 无上限。达到上限后，以此区域为目标的 Transfer 将被拒绝。
description.en: Maximum number of objects this zone can hold. null = unlimited. When full, Transfers targeting this zone are rejected.

definition.zh: 某个时刻游戏世界中为真的断言。描述游戏实体「此刻怎样」，而非「是什么」。State 是运行时事实，随时可被改变。
definition.en: A true assertion about the game world at a given moment. Describes what a game entity 'currently is', not what it 'is'. State is a runtime fact, changeable at any time.

description.zh: 该状态实例的唯一标识符。
description.en: Unique identifier for this state instance.

description.zh: 此状态描述的实体。回答「谁此刻怎样」中的「谁」。指向游戏中一个具体实例（Player、Zone、Piece 等）。例如「Player A 持有 3 个蓝宝石」中，subject = Player A。
description.en: The entity this state describes — the 'who' in 'who is currently in what state'. Points to a concrete game instance. E.g., in 'Player A has 3 blue gems', subject = Player A.

description.zh: 状态值的类型约束。如 "integer"、"boolean"、"player"。程序修改状态时以此校验。
description.en: Type constraint for the state value. E.g., "integer", "boolean", "player". Programs validate state changes against this.

description.zh: 游戏开始时的初始值。用于 setup 和 reset。
description.en: Initial value when the game starts. Used for setup and reset.

definition.zh: 对象或区域固有的、由游戏规则预先定义的特征。描述游戏实体「是什么」「拥有什么能力」「具备什么特点」。默认不可变——在对象进入游戏时即确定，仅在 Effect 明确修改时才变化。
definition.en: An intrinsic characteristic of an object or zone, pre-defined by game rules. Describes what a game entity 'is', 'what abilities it has', 'what traits it possesses'. Immutable by default — set when the object enters the game, only changed by an explicit Effect.

description.zh: 该属性实例的唯一标识符。
description.en: Unique identifier for this property instance.

description.zh: 此属性附着于什么概念或实体。回答「谁拥有这个特征」。可以指向本体概念（"card"，表示所有卡牌）或具体实例（"level_1_card_03"）。
description.en: What concept or entity this property attaches to. Answers 'who has this characteristic'. Can point to an ontology concept ("card") or a specific instance ("level_1_card_03").

description.zh: 属性值的类型约束。如 "integer"、"boolean"、"cost_map"、"effect_spec"。
description.en: Type constraint for the property value. E.g., "integer", "boolean", "cost_map", "effect_spec".

description.zh: 是否可被游戏效果修改。默认 false（静态）。若为 true，修改必须经由 Effect 触发，不可被玩家随意更改。
description.en: Whether this property can be modified by game effects. Default false (static). If true, modification must go through an Effect — players cannot arbitrarily change it.

description.zh: 对象被创建或进入游戏时的默认值。
description.en: Default value when the object is created or enters the game.

definition.zh: 游戏过程中发生的、被游戏规则所识别和定义的、对游戏状态或流程有意义的、不可再分的原子事实。Event 是流程本体的根概念——一切「发生了什么」都始于 Event。
definition.en: An atomic fact that occurs during gameplay, recognized and defined by game rules, meaningful to game state or flow, and not further divisible. Event is the root of the procedure ontology — everything that 'happens' starts from Event.

description.zh: 该事件实例的唯一标识符。
description.en: Unique identifier for this event instance.

description.zh: 导致此事件发生的主体。若事件由玩家主动发起（如 Action），actor 为该玩家。若事件由规则自动引发（如 Trigger），actor 为 null。
description.en: The entity that caused this event. If initiated by a player (e.g. Action), actor is that player. If automatically triggered by rules (e.g. Trigger), actor is null.

description.zh: 此事件作用的目标。可以是 Object、Zone、Player 等。若事件无特定目标（如「回合开始」），target 为 null。
description.en: The target this event acts upon. Can be an Object, Zone, Player, etc. If the event has no specific target (e.g. 'turn begins'), target is null.

definition.zh: 用于判断某个命题在当前游戏状态下是否成立的表达式。Condition 本身不改变任何东西——它只回答「是」或「否」。Condition 是 Rule Engine 的核心判断单元：Action 的合法性检查、Trigger 的激活判断、Endgame 的触发检测，全部由 Condition 驱动。
definition.en: An expression that evaluates whether a proposition is true under the current game state. A Condition changes nothing — it only answers 'yes' or 'no'. Condition is the core judgment unit of the Rule Engine: action legality checks, trigger activation, and endgame detection are all driven by Conditions.

description.zh: 该条件实例的唯一标识符。
description.en: Unique identifier for this condition instance.

description.zh: 此条件的参数。内容由具体的条件类型决定。例如 SupplyCount 条件：{ "resource": "blue", "operator": ">=", "value": 4 }。复合条件（AND/OR）：{ "op": "and", "operands": [condition_ref, ...] }。程序根据条件的 id 查找对应的 evaluator 函数，传入 params 和当前 GameState，返回 boolean。
description.en: Parameters for this condition. Content is determined by the specific condition type. E.g., a SupplyCount condition: { "resource": "blue", "operator": ">=", "value": 4 }. Compound conditions (AND/OR): { "op": "and", "operands": [condition_ref, ...] }. The program looks up the evaluator function by the condition's id, passes params and current GameState, and returns a boolean.

definition.zh: 对象在区域之间移动或所有权变更的事件。
definition.en: An event where an object moves between zones or its ownership changes.

description.zh: 对象移出的源区域。必须是游戏中已定义的一个 Zone 实例。
description.en: The zone the object moves from. Must be a defined Zone instance.

description.zh: 对象移入的目标区域。可以是另一个 Zone，也可以与 source 相同（如区域内重排序）。
description.en: The zone the object moves to. May differ from source or be the same (e.g. reordering within a zone).

description.zh: 被移动的对象。指向游戏中一个具体的 Object 实例。
description.en: The object being moved. References a concrete Object instance.

description.zh: 是否同时改变所有权。若为 true，则 target 区域关联的 Player 成为新所有者。
description.en: Whether ownership also changes. If true, the player associated with the target zone becomes the new owner.

description.zh: 转移的对象数量。Token（可互换）可能 > 1；Piece（不可互换）通常 = 1。
description.en: Quantity transferred. Tokens (interchangeable) may be > 1; Pieces (unique) are usually = 1.
